0022600019.text: The Magic (1-3, 10th in the East) visit the Raptors (3-1, 3rd in the East) for their fifth game of the season, with Orlando 0-2 at home and 1-1 on the road while Toronto is 2-0 at home and has won its last game. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The Raptors beat the Magic 129-99 in Toronto on 2026-10-28, and Orlando trails 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 1-2 in 2025-26.
